remarks: Attractive main free 4 bdrm 3 full bath cape cod in area of Deveaux Niagara Falls. Beautiful eat-in kitchen w/ lots of wood cabinets. Bay window, vinyl flooring, ceiling fan SS appliances (oven/range, refrigerator, dishwasher & microwave). Nice size dining rm also has small breakfast bar, ceiling fan & spacious living rm has bay window, stone wbfp wood mantel, ceiling fan, wall/wall neutral carpeting throughout 1st floor & stairway except bdrms & stunning french dr to foyer w ceramic floor, 2 bdrms on 1st flr have beautiful hdwd look laminate flooring & ceiling fans. Full remodeled bath has tub surround, pedestal sink, C/T walls/flooring. Two bdrms on 2nd floor one is the very spacious master neutral laminate flooring w/ wall of closets & sliding mirrored drs, ceiling fan/light cathedral ceiling & wood skylight window that opens. Also 2nd full bath remodeled w/shower & wd vanity (2020). 4th bdrm across from master perfect for nursery etc wood laminate flooring & ceiling fan. Full dry basement has awesome third full bath w/round shower lots of sprayers on walls. 1 car detached garage door w/door opener (both 2020). Bufftech white 6'fence front & back side of garage done in 2019 & also side dr 2019. LBP clearance inspec done by Stohl 2020 (paperwork avail). Other improvements since 2020: Tear off roof on gar & house, Elec in garage, base, 1st & 2nd flrs, furnace (Heil)& CA, H2O tank, fascia on back of house, painted all awnings front & side house. Great corner lot! Showings and Negotiations begin on Thursday, October 15th at 9:00am.
